title: A portfolio built to evolve
summary: Rebuilding this personal website with Flask, reusable Jinja templates, and a clear structure for technical work.
contribution: I defined the brief, selected a familiar technology stack, and set the content and privacy boundaries. The implementation is being developed with AI assistance.

sections.heading: The starting point
sections.body: The original site was a single HTML page using Bootstrap. It needed clearer navigation, an updated professional introduction, and a maintainable home for technical projects and experience.

sections.heading: The approach
sections.body: Flask renders shared Jinja templates from structured JSON. Project search and category filters work through GET requests, while local CSS, Bootstrap, and small JavaScript modules provide the interface.

sections.heading: Decisions that matter
sections.body: Use technologies I can maintain. Keep content separate from presentation. Validate query parameters, escape displayed input, and handle missing pages deliberately. Preserve the original website while developing the replacement.

sections.heading: Current status
sections.body: The replacement is in local development. This case study describes work in progress, not a production launch or measured business result. The linked public repository may still show the original site.
